annotations.title: Get the product and price for a need

description: Maps what the user needs to one product and returns its prices (once, yearly, first year, excluding 21% VAT), what is included and when they pay. Describe the need in plain words (Dutch or English) and/or pass features. If the need is unclear it asks questions instead of guessing; if it is outside the four products (for example an app for the App Store) it returns no price. Prices come only from the public price list. An indication, not a binding offer. No side effects.

features.description: Optional: what the site must do, from this list. The most capable feature decides the product.

locale.description: Language of the text in the result. Prices are the same in both. Default en.

need.description: What the user needs, in their words (notes), for example: a website for my taxi company where customers can book rides. Required unless product is given.

product.description: Optional: the product id (website, booking, webshop, webapp) to get its fixed price for. When given, it decides the product.
